name: Swarm of Bats

officialCorrection: Monster Manual errata v2.0 p. 2 adds immunity to the grappled condition to swarms on pp. 337–339.

appearanceSource: Editorial description of the existing parchment portrait. The printed block identifies the swarm’s constituent animals.
habitatSource: Tags from the official D&D Beyond legacy listing. The print stat block supplies no habitat list.
